entities.summary: Álvaro Alberto Espinoza Ramírez [es-pe-noh'-zah] is a Venezuelan former professional baseball shortstop. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Minnesota Twins, New York Yankees, Cleveland Indians, New York Mets, and Seattle Mariners. He batted and threw right-handed.
